# thinking-orbs engine (vendored)

The geometry engine of [thinking-orbs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/thinking-orbs) 0.3.2 by Jakub Antalik
([libraries.dev/orbs](https://libraries.dev/orbs)), MIT license (see LICENSE). `engine.js` is the package's
`dist/index-B8WsUNf5.js`, unchanged. The plugin calls only its pure frame functions (`MODE_FRAMES`,
`resolvePreset`) and draws the frames as Braille in the Claude Code pane (`mod/hooks/orb.ts`).
